## Astero Search Track Comparisons (`#430`)

MESA's `astero` search evolves one track per objective evaluation and keeps only the last one in `LOGS/history.data`, so each FlexMESA track is compared with the MESA `26.4.1` track of the same number. `prefix` marks the last track of an unfinished run, compared with the MESA track up to the same `star_age`. A case passes only when it ran as many tracks as MESA, reached upstream's termination, and every track is within the manifest tolerances.
